entry_points.text: Readahead batches tolerant allocations into shared BIO with trailing submit, stopping if folio ends unlocked invalid; single read shares mapping then submits; bulk writeback plugs, iterates dirty folios, submits trailing BIO.

User acquisition maps empty flag to internal allowance with nullable probe; delayed capture, adopt or copy, dismiss or audit-publish; jump swaps targets with checks and reference transfer; parent crossing moves to mountpoint.

Special-file, directory and removal entries take user names descriptor-relative with cwd defaults; unlink validates directory-removal bit, routes dir versus file; symlink and hardlink resolve old and new independently.
Rename flag-carrying plus two flagless compat entries resolve both paths then delegate to shared helper; creation startup takes kernel or user strings propagating flags.
Unmount two-arg and legacy one-arg entries share helper rejecting flags outside force, detach, expire, nofollow, mapping nofollow to unfollowed lookup, resolving relative to cwd.

exports.text: Block multipage readahead, single folio read and bulk writeback batch contiguous blocks into shared BIOs via a mapper, with generic folio fallback.
User acquisition with empty handling and nullable probe; delayed capture adopts unique or copies shared then dismisses or audit-publishes; jump, parent crossing, mount descent transfer references.
Full-path lookup from explicit roots or fd-relative user strings; terminal-device sibling descent; kernel tmpfile open; kernel or user pathname creation startup.
Symlink read via cached, legacy and default paths with bounded user copy; page links share folio acquisition with raw and terminating variants plus release, in an inode ops table.
Mount reclaim via RCU-deferred free and batched workqueue drain; long-term internal versus short-term marks with private internal cloning.

hazards.text: Low-bit decode, RCU-visible deactivating namespaces, build-specific counters, leftover covers risk use-after-free and misaccounting. Transfers release only superseded refs; rename needs global mutex cross-parent, vetoes, limits, dead-marking and detach before replace.

End-of-device guards, hole zeroing, beyond-size truncation, boundary flush, buffer reclaim race concurrent reads; early dirtiness clear, freeing invalid folios or missed size checks lose data or leak stale contents.

Jump must reject scoped, magiclink-disabled, cross-device modes before swap; user names validate memory and empty-versus-null; page links assume no highmem constraints; readlink truncates oversize; unmount validates flags first.

invariants.text: Shared, unbindable, internal and unmount-candidate marks are distinct; becoming shared clears only unbindable. Predecessor low bit carries writer hold and must be decoded.

Read reuses cached extents, needs strict contiguity, zeroes holes, finishes all-hole folios without I/O else fallback. Write needs mapped valid dirty contiguous buffers; tails beyond size zeroed, only mapped prefix submitted.

Lookup holds paths, inode, flags, retry sequences, terminal class, depth, link counts, inline plus extended symlink stack, saved outer state. Name cache fixed after init; terminal covers normal, root, dot, dotdot.
Protected symlink, hardlink, fifo and regular knobs are fs integer sysctls, owner-write world-read, bounded zero to one or two.

Parent resolution needs normal final, returns parent plus name. Lookup splits permission-free handling from parent execute checks, prefers cache with slow miss; positive-only drops negatives as missing.

Mutation startup prechecks with create or remove, killable or noperm variants; dentry forms revalidate aliveness, hashed state, parentage with exists or missing polarity. Sticky allows dir or object owner else privilege; generic create constrains mode, authorizes, constructs, notifies.

Rename allows only no-replace, exchange, whiteout, exchange exclusive; one mount, normalized finals, trailing-slash rules; same object no-op; rights plus security gate; swap, mountpoint, overflow vetoes; delegation breaks; method call; placement update; shared-cookie move records with dir variants; links terminate in bounds, readlink truncates.
Namespace teardown drops passive ref before user-ns and storage, RCU adapter included; id lookup takes passive ref under RCU. Id search returns nearest at-or-above forward, at-or-below reverse.

locks.text: Namespace pointer and flags owned by namespace semaphore; RCU readers hold only passive grace. Id lookup, mountpoint test, unmount busyness use RCU or hash plus read locks with stable-sequence checks.
Parent crossing takes mount seqlock exclusive-read, samples parent and mountpoint with holds, releases, swaps paths; self-parented roots unchanged.
Slow lookup may use shared killable dir lock released before return. Some lookups need caller-held parent lock, warning otherwise; dentry mutation holds nested parent lock on success.

Two-parent rename takes global mutex plus two nested parent locks; single-parent one nested lock only, reversed unlock. Core rename locks victims and moved subdirs by dir rules, address-ordered for non-dir pairs.

state_machines.text: Read BIO starts empty, allocates on first mappable folio, appends while contiguous, resubmits on discontinuity, boundary or capacity miss, marks folios from status. Write accumulates mapped folios, clears dirtiness after membership, flushes on boundary or truncation.
Delayed filename goes uninitialized to incomplete after capture, duplicating shared inputs, then dismiss-release or audit-publish. Jump adds jumped mark on success only.

Ancestor traps: source ancestor of target invalid; target ancestor of source invalid for exchange else non-empty; disconnected without common ancestor cross-device. Delegation retries locked phase; stale handles retry lookup, releasing write hold first.

Lookup-plus-open maps dir, symlink, device, fifo or socket to distinct failures, enforces missing and exclusive-create conflicts, opens only if lower layers did not. Dentry creation uses combined lookup-open when supported, else separate steps.
Page symlink storage loops write-transaction pair, preserving alloc context around begin, copying payload minus terminator, repeating on short write, dirtying inode only on completion.
Mount listing holds namespace read lock; start seeks by position id, next follows successor or steps past id at end, stop releases, show formats mount.

structs.text: Mount links ancestry, hash, namespace tree, cleanup, sharing, slaves, master, names, mountpoint, visibility, pins, covers, flags, expiry, reuse ids. Hold one; marks one two four eight, unbindable-only clear; internal-ns invalid pointer; ids from 2^31; unmount flags one two four; tables carry sysctl limit, boot hash sizes, options hook, event counter, emptied-ns, fs identity, null instances.

Lookup bundles paths, inode, flags, sequences, terminal class, depth, link stack with two inline levels plus extension, filename, saved state, dir identity; locations are mount-plus-dentry pairs; proc iterator pairs namespace, root, show callback. Root bits one two four; walk modes one two four; dot word-sized; controls zero to one or two; cookie zero.
Read aggregation keeps folio, page allowance, readahead mode, active BIO, contiguity state, scratch, cached logical start, mapper for extent reuse. Write keeps active BIO, last block, mapper.

Attribute change groups set and clear masks with propagation and lookup controls, recursive versus idmap-replace kind in low two bits, user-ns and idmap refs. Cover links cover and pin tables with dentry, mountpoint, reclaim state; pinned mountpoint carries mountpoint and parent.
